```{r}
# Separate features from metadata
feature_cols <- paste0("feat_", 1:120)
X <- as.matrix(df[, feature_cols])
labels <- df$accent
speakers <- paste0(df$speaker_id, "_", df$accent)
genders <- df$gender

cat("Feature matrix:", nrow(X), "x", ncol(X), "\n")
```

```{r}

# Manual multivariate Gaussian log-density
# Computes log N(x mu, sigma^2) for diagonal covariance.
#
# log N(x | mu, sigma^2) = -0.5 * [ D*log(2*pi) + sum(log(sigma^2)) + sum((x - mu)^2 / sigma^2) ]

log_gauss_density <- function(X, mu, sigma2) {
  D <- length(mu)

  const <- -0.5 * D * log(2 * pi)
  log_det <- -0.5 * sum(log(sigma2))

  diff <- sweep(X, 2, mu)
  scaled <- sweep(diff^2, 2, sigma2, "/")
  mahal <- -0.5 * rowSums(scaled)

  return(const + log_det + mahal)
}

```

```{r}
# EM algorithm for diagonal-covariance GMM

fit_gmm <- function(X, K, max_iter = 100, tol = 1e-4) {
  N <- nrow(X)
  D <- ncol(X)

  init_idx <- sample(N, K)
  means <- X[init_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  vars <- matrix(1, nrow = K, ncol = D)
  weights <- rep(1 / K, K)

  prev_ll <- -Inf

  for (iter in 1:max_iter) {

# E step
    log_resp <- matrix(0, nrow = N, ncol = K)
    for (k in 1:K) {
      log_resp[, k] <- log(weights[k]) + log_gauss_density(X, means[k, ], vars[k, ])
    }

    # Normalize with log-sum-exp
    log_sum <- apply(log_resp, 1, function(row) {
      m <- max(row)
      m + log(sum(exp(row - m)))
    })
    resp <- exp(sweep(log_resp, 1, log_sum))
    total_ll <- sum(log_sum)
    if (abs(total_ll - prev_ll) < tol) break
    prev_ll <- total_ll

    # M step
    Nk <- colSums(resp)

    for (k in 1:K) {
      if (Nk[k] < 1e-10) next

      weights[k] <- Nk[k] / N
      means[k, ] <- colSums(resp[, k] * X) / Nk[k]

      diff <- sweep(X, 2, means[k, ])
      vars[k, ] <- colSums(resp[, k] * diff^2) / Nk[k]
      vars[k, ] <- pmax(vars[k, ], 1e-6)
    }
  }


  return(list(
    weights = weights,
    means = means,
    vars = vars,
    K = K,
    D = D,
    log_likelihood = total_ll,
    n_params = K * (1 + D + D) - 1
  ))
}

```

```{r}
# BIC computation and model selection
# BIC = -2 * log_likelihood + n_params * log(N)

compute_bic <- function(model, N) {
  return(-2 * model$log_likelihood + model$n_params * log(N))
}

select_best_gmm <- function(X, max_K, max_iter = 100) {
  N <- nrow(X)
  best_model <- NULL
  best_bic <- Inf

  for (K in 1:max_K) {
    cat("    Trying K =", K, "...")
    model <- fit_gmm(X, K, max_iter)
    bic <- compute_bic(model, N)
    cat("    BIC:", round(bic, 1), "\n")

    if (bic < best_bic) {
      best_bic <- bic
      best_model <- model
    }
  }

  cat("Best K:", best_model$K, "with BIC:", round(best_bic, 1), "\n")
  return(list(model = best_model, bic = best_bic))
}

```



```{r}
# Compute log-likelihood of test data under a GMM
# log P(X|model) = log(sum_k weight_k * N(X|mu_k, sigma_k^2))

gmm_log_likelihood <- function(X, model) {
  N <- nrow(X)
  K <- model$K

  log_weighted <- matrix(0, nrow = N, ncol = K)
  for (k in 1:K) {
    log_weighted[, k] <- log(model$weights[k]) + log_gauss_density(X, model$means[k, ], model$vars[k, ])
  }

  log_probs <- apply(log_weighted, 1, function(row) {
    m <- max(row)
    m + log(sum(exp(row - m)))
  })

  return(log_probs)
}

```



```{r}
#  Leave-one-speaker-out cross-validation
# For each speaker: train on all other speakers, predict on held-out.
# This gives the most reliable evaluation with only 32 speakers.

unique_speakers <- unique(speakers)
accent_classes <- sort(unique(labels))
n_classes <- length(accent_classes)

all_preds <- c()
all_true <- c()
all_speakers <- c()
all_genders <- c()
all_log_scores <- matrix(nrow = 0, ncol = n_classes)
colnames(all_log_scores) <- accent_classes

for (fold in seq_along(unique_speakers)) {
  held_out <- unique_speakers[fold]
  train_mask <- speakers != held_out
  test_mask <- speakers == held_out

  X_train <- X[train_mask, ]
  X_test <- X[test_mask, , drop = FALSE]
  y_train <- labels[train_mask]
  y_test_fold <- labels[test_mask]

  train_means <- colMeans(X_train)
  train_sds <- apply(X_train, 2, sd)
  train_sds[train_sds == 0] <- 1

  X_train_scaled <- scale(X_train, center = train_means, scale = train_sds)
  X_test_scaled <- scale(X_test, center = train_means, scale = train_sds)

  # Train one GMM per accent
  fold_gmms <- list()
  fold_priors <- list()

  for (accent in accent_classes) {
    accent_data <- X_train_scaled[y_train == accent, ]
    n_samples <- nrow(accent_data)

    fold_priors[[accent]] <- 1 / n_classes

    max_K <- min(16, floor(n_samples / 10))
    max_K <- max(max_K, 2)

    result <- select_best_gmm(accent_data, max_K)
    fold_gmms[[accent]] <- result$model
  }

  # Predict on held-out speaker
  n_test_fold <- nrow(X_test_scaled)
  log_scores_fold <- matrix(0, nrow = n_test_fold, ncol = n_classes)
  colnames(log_scores_fold) <- accent_classes

  for (j in seq_along(accent_classes)) {
    accent <- accent_classes[j]
    log_ll <- gmm_log_likelihood(X_test_scaled, fold_gmms[[accent]])
    log_prior <- log(fold_priors[[accent]])
    log_scores_fold[, j] <- log_ll + log_prior
  }

  pred_indices <- apply(log_scores_fold, 1, which.max)
  fold_preds <- accent_classes[pred_indices]

  # Store results
  all_preds <- c(all_preds, fold_preds)
  all_true <- c(all_true, y_test_fold)
  all_speakers <- c(all_speakers, rep(held_out, n_test_fold))
  all_genders <- c(all_genders, genders[test_mask])
  all_log_scores <- rbind(all_log_scores, log_scores_fold)

  cat("  Speaker", held_out, ":", sum(fold_preds == y_test_fold),
      "/", length(y_test_fold), "correct\n")
}

y_test <- all_true
y_pred <- all_preds
speakers_test <- all_speakers
genders_test <- all_genders
log_scores <- all_log_scores

cat("Total predictions:", length(y_pred))
```




```{r}
# Evaluation metrics
accuracy <- mean(y_pred == y_test)

cat("BAYESIAN GMM RESULTS:\n")
cat("Overall accuracy:", round(accuracy, 4), "\n\n")

# Confusion matrix
cm_table <- table(Predicted = factor(y_pred, levels = accent_classes),
                  True = factor(y_test, levels = accent_classes))
cat("Confusion matrix:\n")
print(cm_table)

# Per-class precision, recall, F1
cat("\nPer-accent metrics:\n")
cat(sprintf("%-12s  Precision  Recall  F1      Support\n", "Accent"))
cat("---------------------------------------------------\n")

for (accent in accent_classes) {
  tp <- sum(y_pred == accent & y_test == accent)
  fp <- sum(y_pred == accent & y_test != accent)
  fn <- sum(y_pred != accent & y_test == accent)

  precision <- ifelse(tp + fp > 0, tp / (tp + fp), 0)
  recall <- ifelse(tp + fn > 0, tp / (tp + fn), 0)
  f1 <- ifelse(precision + recall > 0, 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall), 0)
  support <- sum(y_test == accent)

  cat(sprintf("%-12s  %.4f     %.4f  %.4f  %d\n",
              accent, precision, recall, f1, support))
}
```

```{r}
# Confusion matrix heatmap

cm_matrix <- as.matrix(cm_table)

heatmap(cm_matrix,
        Rowv = NA, Colv = NA,
        scale = "none",
        margins = c(8, 8),
        main = "Confusion Matrix")
```
